description: **The project describes itself consistently on PyPI, npm and in its README.** The PyPI page had no long description or project links, the npm and Python descriptions differed, and the README opened with a tagline instead of a definition.

**Documentation links point at the unified site.** The declared docs base was the retired per-project host; it is `https://smmh.dev/wesktop/` now, so generated sitemaps, feeds and llms.txt name the address that serves the pages.
